title: City not found
detail: "den_haag" is not a city Socials Homes covers. Close matches: the_hague. It covers 124 cities; GET https://www.socials.homes/api/v1/cities lists them.
resolution: Use a slug from GET https://www.socials.homes/api/v1/cities, for example amsterdam or the_hague. Slugs are lowercase and use underscores.
